basics.name: Ahmet Ozan ÖZGEN
basics.label: Pharm. (MSc) | Senior Clinical Research Specialist
basics.summary: Clinical research and business development professional with expertise in bioavailability and bioequivalence studies, clinical trials, regulatory compliance, contracts, and stakeholder management. Applies data science and programming to healthcare and pharmaceutical research problems.

work.name: Nobel İlaç
work.summary: Support preclinical and clinical activities, regulatory submissions in more than 50 countries, and R&D timelines for product launches.
highlights: Negotiated contracts with more than 15 CROs across Europe, Jordan, and India and established partnerships with service vendors.
Prepared clinical and non-clinical CTD modules for more than 80 medicinal products, including biosimilars, and conducted preliminary research for more than 30 generic and biosimilar projects.

Integrated IMP procurement and regulatory affairs requests into an online platform; developed RPA software for study timelines and EC/MoH applications and a retrieval-augmented generation system for regulatory guidelines.

Conducted monitoring visits for two clinical trials and 20 bioequivalence studies; completed site qualification audits at four sites in Türkiye and six in India; and performed feasibility visits at more than 15 public and university hospitals in Türkiye.
Served as the accountable person for organizing pharmacovigilance activities within clinical trials.
Processed more than 60 regulatory authority inquiries and deficiencies and supported CAPA preparation following a BfArM site audit for a bioequivalence project.
Organized and facilitated four investigator meetings.

work.name: Biocalis
work.summary: Managed healthcare accounts across EMEA and Central Asia, coordinating offices in Albania, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, and Russia while using HubSpot CRM and Excel to track account performance.
highlights: Conducted market research on biomarkers of interest to CDMOs, CROs, and research organizations and generated leads using Springer's AdisInsight.
Opened new PCR-kit accounts in Croatia, Romania, the UAE, and Pakistan during the COVID-19 pandemic; these accounts later distributed additional in-vitro diagnostics.
Identified a gap in the Albanian market, proposed cefuroxime for the local portfolio, and coordinated registration, contributing to significant revenue growth during the pandemic.
Integrated AI-powered 3D/4D aesthetic simulation software into the plastic surgery portfolio and trained more than 20 plastic surgeons.
Created educational and promotional materials that supported delivery of the Allurion intragastric balloon to more than 3,000 patients in Türkiye.

work.name: Avaroğlu Pharmacy
work.summary: Coordinated safe and effective medication therapy for patients and adapted pharmacy operations during the COVID-19 pandemic.

work.name: University Hospital, Retail Pharmacies, and Pharmaceutical Company
work.summary: Completed three months in a university hospital as a clinical pharmacist, five months in retail pharmacies, and one month in a pharmaceutical company's marketing department.

volunteer.position: Youth Assembly and Assistant Pharmacists Commission Member
volunteer.summary: Contributed to projects connecting the UN Sustainable Development Goals with pharmacy practice and volunteered for one week at a field pharmacy in Antakya after the 6 February 2023 earthquakes.

volunteer.position: ICT Talent Program Participant and Team Lead
volunteer.summary: Led a team of 10 that developed an AI-driven concept to prevent violence against healthcare workers. The team won the Türkiye stage of the competition and participated in the European Talent Summit in Athens.

volunteer.summary: Represented Istanbul Medipol University for two years and helped organize the first and second Pharmacist Youth Meetings in 2018 and 2019.
